statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The service is intended to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances
The service is intended to correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval
